name: Project plan
goal: When a project is set up, a project plan entails the most important information about the project, like the context of the company, stakeholders, the assignment, and broad planning.

approach.text: I started out by looking at the structure of previously made project plans. This gave me the first iteration of the document where I included most of the necessary information.

I had a meeting planned with Mr Schifferling, a teacher at Fontys, in which we discussed the project proposal (a very small version of the context and assignment) and the goal of the project. He mentioned critical information that needed to be included into the project plan, like the existing products of the company, what the target audience is for the game, why a new game was created rather than an existing one used.

As the design challenge needs to be very specific, I have had a conversation with the developer that worked on the project before me: Kayleigh Westerweele. She gave me some tips on how to further improve the design challenge, as seen in the picture below:<<image 1.png>>I further reiterated on the design challenge and added it to the project plan.

I asked Kayleigh Westerweele to show me her project plan so I would know what I missed in my own. I then asked her for all the documents, where I was given the link to her portfolio, and I looked more through the existing project to analyse the current state of the project and come up with a list of changed that need to happen.

normalLearnings: I learned more details to be included in the project proposal and project plan.
I learned that as an expansion or continuation of an existing project, I have to make a thorough analysis of the current state of the project.
result: The result can be found in the document below, which is also listed as a product in this project.
validation: I validated the project plan with my first assessor, who gave me feedback on which I revised the document.
contribution: The project plan is one of the foundations of the project, as it sets boundaries on what I will and will not work on during the project. It also includes details on planning and contact information. The next step in the project is to start the research of the project.
